# PCA — Dimensionality Reduction

This project demonstrates dimensionality reduction using Principal Component Analysis (PCA).

## Features
- Feature scaling
- PCA transformation
- Explained variance analysis
- 2D visualization of high-dimensional data
- Save trained PCA model

## Use Case
Reduces dimensionality while preserving most of the information.

## How to Run

1. Install dependencies:

pip install -r requirements.txt

2. Run notebook:

jupyter notebook notebook/pca_dimensionality_reduction.ipynb
